[HISTÓRICO REDACTADO PARA HANDOFF: líneas de credenciales/configuración excluidas; original intacto en notebook.]

// Sonda de privacidad del lado Rider. Usa un JWT de rider REAL y registra su
// sesion, o sea que corre con TODOS los privilegios que la app tiene, y trata
// de salirse del contrato de la oferta. Solo backend descartable local.
const API = 'http://127.0.0.1:54421';
[EXCLUIDO: credencial/configuración; recrear localmente.]
const BUSINESS = 'b0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
const ORDERS = {
  A: '0a000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001',
  B: '0a000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002',
  C: '0a000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003',
  D: '0a000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004',
  E: '0a000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005',
};

const r = await fetch(`${API}/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password`, {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { apikey: ANON, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
[EXCLUIDO: credencial/configuración; recrear localmente.]
});
const token = (await r.json()).access_token;

async function get(path) {
  const res = await fetch(`${API}/rest/v1/${path}`, {
    headers: { apikey: ANON, Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
  });
  const t = await res.text();
  return { status: res.status, body: t.length > 400 ? t.slice(0, 400) + '...' : t };
}
async function rpc(fn, args = {}) {
  const res = await fetch(`${API}/rest/v1/rpc/${fn}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { apikey: ANON, Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(args),
  });
  const t = await res.text();
  return { status: res.status, body: t.length > 600 ? t.slice(0, 600) + '...' : t };
}

await rpc('identity_register_session', { p_business_id: BUSINESS, p_client: 'rider_android' });

const probes = {
  'orders: tabla entera': await get('orders?select=*'),
  'orders: pedido A ofrecido, campos privados': await get(`orders?id=eq.${ORDERS.A}&select=customer_name,customer_phone,customer_street_address,total`),
  'orders: pedido B NO ofrecido': await get(`orders?id=eq.${ORDERS.B}&select=customer_name,customer_phone,customer_street_address`),
  'order_delivery_handoffs: PINes': await get('order_delivery_handoffs?select=*'),
  'order_public_tokens: tokens de seguimiento': await get('order_public_tokens?select=*'),
  'rider_order_offers: ofertas crudas': await get('rider_order_offers?select=*'),
  'payment_intents: cobros': await get('payment_intents?select=*'),
  'rpc get_rider_delivery_board (contrato legitimo)': await rpc('get_rider_delivery_board'),
};

for (const [name, out] of Object.entries(probes)) {
  console.log(`\n--- ${name}\n  status=${out.status}\n  body=${out.body}`);
}
